subject: A conforming implementation
notes: kb/Work PB1525 landed (wave 1020 A). The class-1 element (a documented language element ISO does not define) is conforming ONLY with the two obligations the paragraph names, and both now hold. DOCUMENTATION: docs/CONFORMANCE.md 3.2 identifies every nonstandard extension for which support is claimed - the COMP-1..COMP-5 / COMPUTATIONAL-1..5 usages, GOBACK RETURNING/GIVING, SET program-pointer TO ENTRY, the --source-format auto reference-format detection - and the words reserved for ENTRY / JSON / XML (refused by name, no support claimed), one table row per row of the register NonstandardExtensionRegister (src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Editions/NonstandardExtension.cs), held equal to it by NonstandardExtensionRegisterDriftTests; the reserved-word half (D-RW1) is held equal to the rows' ReservedWords. WARNING MECHANISM: `cobol --flag-extensions` (CompilerDriver.Options.FlagExtensions -> EditionContext.FlagExtensions), read by the ONE seam EditionContext.Extension, writes COBOL2894 once per use, at every edition, and never changes whether the program compiles; MEASURED on this build: probe ext1.cob (PIC S9(5) COMP-3, PIC S9(5) COMP-5, COMP-2) draws three COBOL2894 at --std 85 and 2023 with the flag and none without. A usage spelling is found BY ROW in the one usage funnel (PictureAnalyzer.ParseUsage), GOBACK RETURNING at the one decode (CallBinder.DecodeGobackPhrases, program and method arm alike), SET TO ENTRY at SetBinder.BindSetEntry. SYNTACTICALLY DISTINGUISHABLE: --source-format auto is documented and never flagged (not a property of the text), and a refused vendor statement is an error already. SCOPE OF THE REGISTER, DECIDED: constructs --permissive accepts are violations of a standard rule flagged unconditionally by their own named warning (EditionContext.Removed), never accepted in silence, so they are not rows; --sign-encoding is implementor latitude. A silent extension found later is a ROW (and its binder site); the drift tests refuse an accepted row nothing names. Verdict DIVERGES -> CONFORMS.
